extDescription.message: Received Header Inspector lets you read the sending servers and check domains to help detect spoofing in your email. Some basic knowledge of how email and message headers work is recommended to get the most out of this tool.

reminderPart2.message: Other fields should be interpreted with caution, as they can be deliberately altered to deceive you (spoofing).

errorSubject.message: Error: unable to retrieve the subject

errorFrom.message: Error: unable to retrieve the sender

errorServer.message: Error: unable to retrieve the server

reminderSuffix.message: is the only piece of information that is hard to forge.
